name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (recruitment/menu domain implied by callers). 'count_selected_chars' accurately describes the behavior: it counts the selected party members (characters) in the recruitment selection_state array. No Ghidra address residue in the name (no hex suffix matching 0x320ce or any data address). Confirmed by both callers (render counter display + auto-commit-when-count==max).
purpose: Count the number of selected (toggled-on) party members in the recruitment-screen per-member selection_state byte array.
logic_summary: Iterates iter over [0, data_fd2_shared_menu_party_member_count - 1) and increments a running count for each non-zero byte at sel_state[iter]; returns the count. The exclusive upper bound (count-1) skips the final sentinel slot. Compiler-generated __CHK(8) stack-probe prologue precedes the body; running count is held in EBX and moved to EAX by the shared epilogue. Verified against disassembly: MOV ECX,[ESP+8] (sel_state); MOV EDX,[0x53bfb] / DEC EDX (member_count-1) as loop bound; CMP byte[ECX+EAX],0 / INC EBX accumulates.

params.name: sel_state
params.semantics: Base address (as integer) of the per-member selection_state byte array; sel_state[i] != 0 means member i is selected. Both callers pass the address of their local selection_state[32] array.
params.reason: Clear abbreviation of selection_state, matches actual use as the selection_state array pointer; no address residue, descriptive.

returns.semantics: Number of selected members (count of non-zero bytes over the scanned range). Consumed by callers: render screen shows 'N selected'/'max-N remaining'; branch screen auto-commits when the value equals max_chars.

issues.title: Duplicate prototype for fd2_count_selected_chars in protos.h
issues.description: protos.h declares fd2_count_selected_chars twice: line 784 (int fd2_count_selected_chars(uint32 sel_state);) and line 796 (int  fd2_count_selected_chars(uint32 selection_state);). The two declarations are C-compatible (same return/param type, only the param name differs) so it still compiles, but the redundant + name-divergent prototype should be deduplicated. The sibling functions fd2_reorder_party_by_selection (lines 785/797) and fd2_pin_required_char_to_party_slot1 (lines 786/799) have the same duplicate-prototype situation. Not a logic issue; deferred to declaration/Stage-2 cleanup, not fixed this phase.
issues.evidence: grep protos.h: line 784 'int fd2_count_selected_chars(uint32 sel_state);' and line 796 'int  fd2_count_selected_chars(uint32 selection_state);'

notes: Comment block in misc.c (lines 206-226) is already comprehensive and accurate (matches both callers and disassembly), kept as-is. Ghidra plate is consistent with the src understanding, left unchanged. Source emits no code change this phase; only the shard is committed. Disassembly verified: __CHK(8) prologue, loop bound = [0x53bfb] (data_fd2_shared_menu_party_member_count) - 1, count in EBX -> EAX via shared epilogue at 0x2d85b.
